dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Arachatora, Arasaka, Arapas, and Araphala ran away with sobs, after Arapacati got angry.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: They have been making food and repenting, carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Thanks to Nara {NICKNAME}, or they will keep seeing cooking training as the most important, and forget Arapacati's words about no fights.
